claims: "No Kings" is a nationwide, nonviolent protest movement in the U.S.
"No Kings" opposes the second Trump administration's policies and alleged authoritarianism
"No Kings" is led by the 50501 movement and coalition partners
Major "No Kings" protests occurred in June 2025
Major "No Kings" protests occurred in October 2025
Major "No Kings" protests occurred in March 2026
"No Kings" protests featured thousands of rallies
"No Kings" movement organizers call "authoritarian actions," "dictatorship," and the "militarization" of democracy by the Trump administration
March 28, 2026 "No Kings" events occurred in over 3,000 communities
March 28, 2026 "No Kings" events included major demonstrations in New York
March 28, 2026 "No Kings" events included major demonstrations in Washington, D.C.
"No Kings" protests are organized by a broad coalition including the 50501 movement, Indivisible, the ACLU, and various labor unions and grassroots organizations
The name "No Kings" stems from a rejection of the idea of an American presidency acting as a "king"
"No Kings" movement launched in June 2025 to oppose the administration's power moves
"No Kings" demonstrators have rallied against mass deportation
"No Kings" demonstrators have rallied against the war in Iran
"No Kings" demonstrators have rallied against rising costs of living
"No Kings" demonstrators have rallied against perceived attacks on First Amendment rights
